verses.1: How great is this gold! It makes the best ornaments. The precious stones are used to adorn everything.
verses.2: The precious children of Zion, who are so numerous, are considered to be creatures of creation, works of the Creator’s hands.
verses.3: And they also took out the bodies of the slain. They buried them in my land, as a sign of their cruelty.
verses.4: They clung to their straw, hoping for bread during the night. But they had no bread to eat.
verses.5: The food for the travelers was stored in the corners of the houses, on top of piles of trash.
verses.6: And the punishment for my people became greater than the suffering of Sodom. It was a moment of great pain, and no one could heal them with their hands.
verses.7: May their monks be freed from the ice and snow; may they be freed from the bondage of earth. May their bodies be adorned with pearls.
verses.8: It was dark from the darkness of the night. They couldn’t be seen in the distance. Their bodies were covered with dust; they resembled trees.
verses.9: The good were the spaces of darkness, compared to the spaces of hunger that were filled with filth from the dung in the fields.
verses.10: The hands of merciful women became channels through which their children could be nourished. They were like springs from which nourishment flowed for my people’s children.
verses.11: The LORD poured out his wrath; fire spread throughout the land, and its fruits were destroyed.
verses.12: The kings of the earth did not believe that a famine and destruction would come upon the streets of Jerusalem.
verses.13: From their prophets’ graves rise up the priests, who pour blood of righteous people into their graves.
verses.14: They wandered around in the streets, covered in blood. They couldn’t even move their limbs properly.
verses.15: “Suru Tamae called out to him. Suru, Suru! Do not touch them, for they have already gone away. They said in the lands: ‘They will not stay here anymore.’”
verses.16: The faces of the LORD’s priests shall not be brought into sight; they shall not be honored, nor should the elders be given any place of honor either.
verses.17: Our eyes are turned away from our helpers; we look for help in a land that will not be saved.
verses.18: Our steps have led us through the depths of our own land. Our enemies have filled our days with suffering, for our enemies have arrived.
verses.19: Our pursuers were those who came from the skies. They rushed down from the mountains and attacked us in the desert.
verses.20: The spirit of the Lord Jesus Christ has been captured by their sins. But we have said in His name that we will live in nations.
verses.21: Let me rejoice and be glad, for the daughter of Adam sits in a land of thorns. Even upon you will fall the curse; I will hire and set you free.
verses.22: Do not let the daughter of Zion boast; she cannot reveal her faults. Let the daughter of Adam be ashamed of her sins.
